name: Yuuki Noa
source:
"I can't trust you two."

A second-year student at Kuho Girls Academy.

Shrouded in mystery, Yuuki is an enigmatic girl who attends another school. The only thing known about her is her passion for parfaits.

Hobbies: Creating dollhouses
Likes: Animals
Dislikes: People who act way more familiar than they actually are
